## Workflow 4 — Main Chatbot Router

**After import:**
1. In **Call Workflow 2 - Nike RAG**, select your existing Workflow 2.
2. In **Call Workflow 3 - Shopify**, select your existing Workflow 3.
3. Each child workflow needs a **When Executed by Another Workflow** trigger set to **Accept all data**, connected to its existing processing path.
4. Do not remove or rebuild the existing child logic.
